title: [2n] 公会血祭规则|[2n] Guild Blood Sacrifice Rules
zh:
1. {"血祭"|"color": "s"}释放的地点由公会成员共同投票决定。其中{"血祭"|"color": "s"}拥有者拥有的票数权重为总票数的百分之二十，若投票人数不足 25 人则以 5 票计，不足 1 票的部分以一票计；会长拥有票数为 3 票，副会长拥有票数为 2 票，公会成员拥有的票数为 1 票。选择票数最高的地图进行{"血祭"|"color": "s"}，投票入口详见公会官网，投票截止时间为{"血祭"|"color": "s"}预计时间的前 12 个小时，由管理员进行统计票数，若成员有重复投票则以最后一次投票计为有效投票。
2. {"血祭"|"color": "s"}释放的时间定在{"血祭"|"color": "s"}拥有者公布有{"血祭"|"color": "s"}后至少1天以后（有充足的时间去准备、通知）
3. {"血祭"|"color": "s"}时间、地点商讨确定后需要通知其他公会成员进行准备，途径包括但不限于公会群聊、公会通知、公会官网通知、游戏内群聊（不推荐）。
4. 公会官网暂时由副会长维护，公会官网的通知暂时只有副会长和会长有权限编辑，若要发布{"血祭"|"color": "s"}相关通知，需要对内容进行加密并在公会范围内通知密码。如果你有制作页面的才能，也可以申请成为公会页面的协作者。
5. 选择合适的服务器（如中国玩家多时选择 US 或 EU），尽量选择人少的服务器释放{"血祭"|"color": "s"}。
6. 提前踩点，对于普通地图由约 5～8 人提前 15min 进行踩点，确认地点人少、与出生点有一定距离，并将结果反馈至游戏群聊和公会群聊。对于 py 地图由 10+人提前 30min 进行寻找地图，地图找到后在公会群聊里提供无痕版本与标记版本的地图，再由官网维护者上传无痕版本的地图或加密上传标记版本的地图。
7. 公会成员数至少占参与{"血祭"|"color": "s"}人数的 75%，可以邀请个别外公会成员参与，但不要将信息传播出去。当人数未达标时，由会长与蹭{"血祭"|"color": "s"}者进行协商，若协商无果则推迟{"血祭"|"color": "s"} 15～30min 并以票数第二高的非 py 地图补位进行，具体信息需在公会聊天以及公会官网通知中传达到位，同时若是公会级别的协商无果，则将该公会计入{"Mark List"|"color": "l"}。
8. 对于普通地图，所有成员可以提前 8 分钟左右开始跑图；对于 py 地图，所有成员可以提前 12～15 分钟开始跑图，并确保自己熟悉路线。如果 py 地图距离上次地图刷新已经过了很久，则需现场决定是快速进行还是更换普通地图。
9. {"血祭"|"color": "s"}拥有者可以主动提出与高等级者组队的要求，高等级者需在 5min 内落实，若人未到齐则视情况推迟 5min 左右，释放{"血祭"|"color": "s"}需听会长指挥，不受其他人干扰。若会长不在则由公会最高等级者接管指挥权。
10. {"血祭"|"color": "s"}开始后在确保自己能 loot 的情况下尽量 {"y"|"color": "u"}{"g"|"color": "m"}{"g"|"color": "l"} 公会成员，不要出现 {"troller"|"color": "l"} 以及 {"mark"|"color": "l"} 的情况。若有外公会的 {"troller"|"color": "l"} 或 {"pusher"|"color": "l"}，则先尽力将其解决，{"血祭"|"color": "s"}完成后记入 {"Mark List"|"color": "l"}。
11. {"血祭"|"color": "s"}结束后会长会将{"血祭"|"color": "s"}视频上传至 {"B站"|"color": "u"}，所以大家在聊天时请注意不要出现敏感词汇。
en:
1. {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} release location shall be decided by a joint vote of guild members. The {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} owner has a vote weight of 20% of the total votes. If the number of voting members is less than 25, the owner's vote counts as 5 votes; any fractional vote is rounded up to 1. The guild leader has 3 votes, vice leaders have 2 votes each, and ordinary guild members have 1 vote each. The map with the highest votes shall be chosen for the {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"}. The voting portal can be found on the guild's official website. The voting deadline is 12 hours before the scheduled {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} time. The administrator will tally the votes. If a member votes multiple times, only the last vote shall count as valid.
2. The {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} release time shall be set at least 1 day after the owner announces they possess a {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} (to allow sufficient time for preparation and notification).
3. Once the {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} time and location are confirmed, other guild members must be notified to prepare. Methods include but are not limited to: guild group chat, guild announcement, guild website announcement, and in-game group chat (not recommended).
4. The guild's official website is temporarily maintained by the vice leaders. Only the guild leader and vice leaders have permission to edit announcements on the website. If a {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} notice is to be published, the content must be encrypted, and the password shall be shared within the guild. If you have the skills to create web pages, you may apply to become a collaborator on the guild page.
5. Choose an appropriate server (e.g., US or EU when most players are Chinese). Try to release the {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} on a server with few people.
6. Advance scouting: For normal maps, 5~8 people shall scout 15 minutes in advance, confirm that the location has few people and is at a reasonable distance from the spawn point, and report the result in both the in-game and guild group chats. For py maps, 10+ people shall scout 30 minutes in advance to locate the map. Once found, provide both a clean version and a marked version of the map in the guild group chat. The website maintainer shall then upload the clean version publicly or the marked version encrypted.
7. At least 75% of participants in the {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} must be guild members. A few outsiders may be invited, but do not spread the information. If the quota is not met, the guild leader shall negotiate with the outsiders. If negotiations fail, postpone the {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} by 15~30 minutes and substitute the map with the second-highest voted non-py map. Specific information must be communicated in both the guild chat and the guild website announcement. If a guild-level negotiation fails, that guild shall be added to the {"Mark List"|"color": "l"}.
8. For normal maps, all members may start running to the location about 8 minutes in advance. For py maps, all members may start running 12~15 minutes in advance and make sure they are familiar with the route. If a long time has passed since the last py map refresh, the group shall decide on the spot whether to proceed quickly or switch to a normal map.
9. The {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} owner may proactively request to team up with higher-level players. The higher-level players must confirm within 5 minutes. If not all are present, the start may be delayed by about 5 minutes depending on the situation. The {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} shall be released under the command of the guild leader, without interference from others. If the guild leader is absent, the highest-level guild member present shall take command.
10. Once the {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} begins, try to {"Y"|"color": "u"}{"G"|"color": "m"}{"G"|"color": "l"} guild members as long as you can secure your own loot. Do not act as a {"troller"|"color": "l"} or {"mark"|"color": "l"}. If an outsider {"troller"|"color": "l"} or {"pusher"|"color": "l"} appears, do your best to deal with them first. After the {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} is complete, add that person to the {"Mark List"|"color": "l"}.
11. After the {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} ends, the guild leader will upload the {"Blood Sacrifice"|"color": "s"} video to {"Bilibili"|"color": "u"}. Therefore, everyone should be careful not to use sensitive words in chat.
